# northflank_project (Data Source)

Looks up a Northflank project in the token's team, either by its `id` or by its `name`. Set exactly one of them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By ID.
data "northflank_project" "by_id" {
  id = "my-application"
}

# By name. Names are matched exactly; if several projects share a name, look
# the project up by ID instead.
data "northflank_project" "by_name" {
  name = "My Application"
}

output "project_region" {
  value = data.northflank_project.by_name.region
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the project, such as `my-project`. Set this to look the project up by ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the project. Set this to look the project up by name, which lists the team's projects to find it.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the project runs on: a bring-your-own-cloud cluster, or the managed cluster serving its region.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `description` (String) Short description of the project.
- `region` (String) Region the project is hosted in.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the project. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.
